Maria C: Hey folks — PR #36200 is failing CI on gpu-shard-7 embed tests intermittently. Need a quick decision: rerun or accept a snapshot update? Logs below.

Alex P: Can you paste the failing log lines?

Maria C: sure:
```
FAILED tests/test_embed_index.py::TestEmbedIndex::test_large_batch
AssertionError: arrays not equal
... compare failed at index 0
node: gpu-7, driver reported timeout 12.3s
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.9/site-packages/pytest", line X, in 
    ...
socket.timeout: Read timed out
```

Sophie L: I've seen that one before — usually a noisy shard. Could be transient network or storage. @Kevin (oncall) can you kick a targeted rerun? :eyes:

Kevin (oncall): On it. Triggering targeted rerun for PR 36200 on shard gpu-7 now: `/ci rerun --pr 36200 --shards gpu-7`

ci-bot: Rerun queued (id: rerun-8901) — estimated ~6m to complete.

Alex P: If rerun flakes again, we should bisect or temporarily relax snapshot tolerance. Don't want to keep forcing snapshot updates for infra noise.

Maria C: If rerun passes can someone approve merge? Need to hit the release window. I don't have bypass perms.

Sophie L: I can approve once it's green. Ping me with a ✅

Kevin (oncall): Rerun finished — two jobs passed, one failed again (embed_index on shard gpu-7). Attaching failure snippet:
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests/test_embed_index.py", line 128, in test_large_batch
    assert np.allclose(a, b)
socket.timeout: Read timed out
```
Looks like a read timeout to an internal storage host around test time.

Alex P: Hmm. Could also be driver/PCIe reset or oom leading to hung RPC. Can you paste node logs? `/logs node gpu-7 --last 1h`

Kevin (oncall): Node logs show intermittent `nv_peer_miss` and `io timeout` ~22s around the failing test run. I'll open an infra ticket if it repeats. For now, we should decide: rerun a couple more times or mark flaky and follow up.

Maria C: Proposal: abort merge for now, mark the test flaky and file infra follow-up, but allow this PR to merge with 2 approvals and a TODO in the changelog? Not ideal but avoids blocking the release.

Sophie L: I'd prefer we rerun up to 3 times. If all 3 fail, mark flaky and file follow-up. We have the policy in #eng-oncall — OK to approve post-green with a follow-up issue.

Alex P: I'll kick one more targeted rerun. If it fails again I'll open a bisect ticket and we can consider reverting the change causing stress.

ci-bot: Rerun queued (id: rerun-8902).

Kevin (oncall): FYI opening infra alert: `infra: investigate gpu-7 io timeouts` — adding logs and timestamps.

Maria C: Thanks. @Sophie I'll ping you with results. Anyone else who can approve quickly, please stand by.

Sophie L: watching. :eyes:
